title: Purported AI-Generated Audio Was Reportedly Used to Claim Recep Tayyip Erdoğan Expressed Support for Imran Khan in Pakistani Parliament

behaviors.text: The video is described as having reused footage from 2020 and featured AI-generated audio that fabricated remarks Erdoğan never made.

A reported viral video that was circulated in Pakistan featured purported AI-generated audio depicting Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan expressing support for jailed former Prime Minister a person during his 2025 visit.
